messages:
maria.g: quick heads-up from int3 bring-up on neptune-13b. running a 16k->32k context expansion test with injected system message and we see KV index drift after ~3k new tokens. outputs diverge (same seed) and there's a small but consistent embedding mismatch.
kevin.c: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro? does it happen on cpu or gpu run?
maria.g: GPU (a100). repro is pretty small — prepend a 4-token system message after 8k tokens, continue generation ~3k tokens. i dumped kv index checksums and saw the index anchor shift by +2 at layer 6.
ida: can you share the dump? might be a packing/alignment issue when we switch window sizes under int3 quant path.
maria.g: pasted logs below. note the accessor offsets and the quick checksum lines.

```
[2026-02-10 14:02:11] layer6.kv_index: expected 0x7f8a1c, got 0x7f8a1e
[2026-02-10 14:02:11] kv-checksum: 0x9c8f -> 0x9c92
seed=42
model: neptune-13b-int3
config: ctx=32768, prefill_mode=stream
```
kevin.c: hmm +2 shift sounds like a stride/packing boundary. int3 has 5-bit packing per lane? might be an off-by-one when we switch from 16k tiled buffers to 32k tiled buffers.
ida: try running with KV_DUMP_ALIGN=1 and set PREFILL_STRIDE=64, also run this small check to compare k/v pointer arithmetic across quant and fp16 builds:
```
python -m tests.kv_probe --model neptune-13b --seed 42 --steps 3500 --dump-anchors
```
maria.g: running now. also toggling PREFILL_STRIDE as you suggested.
deploy-bot: build/2026.02.10-int3-compat deployed to staging (neptune-13b-int3). smoke tests queued.
leigh: if it's reproducible, please capture birdseye diffs vs int4 and fp16. i want token-level divergence percentage and a small perplexity delta on our goldset. can we get that in a 1-2 table?
maria.g: will do. early numbers: token divergence ~0.8% after 3k tokens, perplexity delta ~+0.12 on goldset A (longprompt-8k->32k). attaching when done.
kevin.c: also try running with ROTARY_RESCALE=1.0 vs 0.999, sometimes the RoPE handling in the fused kernel miscomputes phase when packing crosses tile boundary.
ida: good call. if ROTARY_RESCALE changes repro rate that's a hint it's RoPE interpolation rather than pure pointer arithmetic.
maria.g: update: with PREFILL_STRIDE=64 + KV_DUMP_ALIGN=1 the drift disappears in 3/3 runs. with ROTARY_RESCALE tweak it reduces but doesn't fully vanish. saving traces and will upload.
leigh: awesome — that suggests two orthogonal mitigations (alignment + rescale). prioritize the alignment fix for int3 bring-up. open a small PR with fallback that forces PREFILL_STRIDE=64 for quant builds and include the test harness.
maria.g: filing PR now. also adding test case to our longctx benchmark and a short note in the onboarding doc about stride/alignment caveat.
kevin.c: nice. once PR lands, let's run matrix across ctx sizes (8k/16k/32k/64k if possible) and quant types (int3/int4/int8) to get a surface map.
ida: +1. i'll help with automated trace comparison script.
maria.g: thanks all, will post results in this thread when matrix finishes. :thumbsup:
